text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After going out with Manhattan Cafe,
we returned to the academy's front gate, when――

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, after this...
would you care for some coffee...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
There are some beans...
I'd really love for you to taste, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Now then, keep your eyes on me...
and follow my lead...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where Manhattan Cafe led me was
her private space inside the academy.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: These are the beans I mentioned earlier...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying so, Manhattan Cafe pointed to the unground coffee beans sitting on the table in a clear jar.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: These are... beans harvested from my coffee plant... and roasted by myself...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
For a single coffee tree to grow enough...
to yield a harvest...
It takes at least... three whole years.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it can only be harvested...
once a year...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
These had to be precious beans that Manhattan Cafe had grown, harvested,
and processed from her very own coffee tree.
choice_data_list: ......Are you sure I can have something so valuable?
......Are you sure I should have something so valuable?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...It is precisely because it's precious.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I roasted these myself...
to match your tastes, Trainer...
I'm sure... you'll find it easy to drink.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: And so――――

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ................Would you like to have a drink with me?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'll brew some right away...
Please wait just a moment...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The quiet sound of Manhattan Cafe brewing coffee
echoes gently throughout the room...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
My parents grow coffee plants too...
Once a year, the whole family...
gathers together to drink it...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Those moments are always like a night under a hazy moon...
so gentle... and so comforting..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking... that I'd like to
spend that kind of time with you too, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
......Thank you for waiting.
Here you go――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I take a sip of the freshly brewed coffee.
Its rich flavor and warmth
spread soothingly throughout my mind and body.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After that, I sat across from Manhattan Cafe,
and the two of us quietly savored our coffee—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, we finished our coffee without either of us saying a single word.
And as the lingering silence hung in the air—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
choice_data_list: I've never had coffee this delicious before.
I've never had coffee this delicious before.
Thank you for a wonderful time.
I want to brew some coffee for you too, Cafe.
I want to brew some coffee for Cafe, too!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
choice_data_list: I've never had coffee this delicious before.
I've never had coffee this delicious before.
Thank you for a wonderful time.
I want to brew some coffee for you too, Cafe.
I want to brew some coffee for Cafe, too!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ......You're exaggerating.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Still——

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Same here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A cup filled with time far more intense than thousands of words.
It became a night whose flavor I knew
I would never forget for all the years to come――

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...The pleasure is mine.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Next year too......
I hope we can be together like this――"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Will you... drink some coffee...?
choice_data_list: Let's drink together again next year, and the year after that.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Next year... and the year after that...
Again...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What will the coffee I share with her taste like next year?
It turned into a night of letting my thoughts drift
to that slightly distant future――

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to try growing one together...?
...A coffee plant.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If we were to plant new ones...
it would take over three years, though—
choice_data_list: I'll do my best looking forward to that moment.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...This has turned into a rather long story, hasn't it?
...Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I am looking forward to it too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure coffee brewed with those beans
will be far more delicious than what I drank today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It became a moment for the two of them to let their thoughts wander toward a future darker than night, and rich with aroma.
